Heard on I.A. No.107/2026 , third application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of the appellant.
2.

This appeal assails the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 09.11.2022 passed by Third Additional Sessions Judge/POCSO Act, Vidisha, whereby present appellant stood convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Section Imprisonment Fine Default  354 of IPC 01 Year's RI 500/- Two months  376(3) of IPC 20 Years' RI 1500/- Five mont  3 (w)(i) of SC/ST Act 06 Months' RI 500/- Two months  3(2)(va)(i) of SC/ST Act 20 Years' RI 1500/- Five mont  33(2) (v) of SC/ST Act Life imprisonment 2000/- Six month 3 .

sentences.text: It is the submission of learned counsel for the appellant that the Trial Court erred in convicting the appellant and awarding jail sentence to him.
It is further submitted that appellant has suffered 04 years and 10 months' incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
It is further submitted that case is of false implication because the dispute shared by the appellant and mother of prosecutrix.
Both were part of catering team and appellant gave some advance money to mother of prosecutrix but she did not turn up for her services as caterer.
In pursuance thereof, this false case is registered 2 CRA-11790-2022 against the appellant just to exert pressure.
Medical report belies the allegations because no injury is sustained by the prosecutrix externally or internally.
Even as per case of prosecution, appellant ought to had sustained some injuries over his right wrist but that was not the case.
Medical report of the appellant does not indicate such injury.
He has a good case on merits and final hearing of the appeal would take some time.
Fine amount has already been deposited.

With the aforesaid submissions, he prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to present appellant till Netram @ Nandu Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34578322/

sentences.text: final disposal of this appeal.
4 . Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.

6. Considering the rival submissions advanced, specially the fact that medical report belies the allegations because no injury is sustained by the prosecutrix externally or internally and appellant has suffered 04 years and 10 months' incarceration and looking to the over all facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the present application but with certain stringent conditions, hence, I.A.
No.107/2026 is allowed .

It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court and appellant's jail sentence shall remain suspended till disposal of this appeal.
Appellant is further directed to remain present before the Registry of this 3 CRA-11790-2022 Court on 24.12.2026 and, thereafter, on such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry.

7. The appellant shall not move in the vicinity of complainant side and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment in any manner, otherwise benefit of grant of suspension of jail sentence shall stand cancelled automatically without any reference to the Court.
8.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
9. Copy of this order be sent to the Trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.

(ANAND PATHAK) (PUSHPENDRA  JUDGE JUDG  (alok)
